name: Date-Sweetened Vanilla Chai Protein Shake
ingredients: vanilla whey-based protein powder (containing 20 grams protein/serving)
instructions: Not all protein powders are created equal. If desired, adjust shake consistency by adding more or less liquid per package instructions. This recipe will make about 8 cups of shake. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Place milk, water, protein powder, yogurt, dates, vanilla, and spices in a blender. Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
To serve, divide shake between glasses, adding ice if desired. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
